question: Does the staged loader reach and register the Supervisor, and complete the installer CPC2 sequence, on the exact 3.1.190 firmware in Mirage?
prototype_hypothesis: The ported VFS/app records must be the 3.1.190 bodies, and the v8 Manager app descriptor must use the 3.1.190 launcher ABI (metadata callback at +0x1c).
callsite_evidence: Mirage firmware miwear.watch.n67cn_v3.1.190_full_3e264bc2; its vela_ap.bin SHA-256 is 3e264bc267431ec71843cc7c2e4acd928b9280ea39ee1cd888636adcebabf82f, equal to the target.

The installer face was installed by replacing the registered market package 366240003 contents (main.lua + profile + stage1/stage2 + Supervisor + icon); resource.bin stays. A new market id is not registered by the firmware's watchface DB and never loads.

Run executed stage0 (cave 0x20080000), stage1 (written into the cave at +0x100), stage2 (Supervisor ELF input in Kmem; resident image from Umem via memalign), the constructor, and opened /dev/canopus.
CPC2 INSTALL 0, INSTALL 2, RESTORE_AFTER_BOOT, INSTALL 1 and INSTALL 2 all returned result 5; the installer displayed 'Run completed'.
/data/canopus/registry.bin is written with magic CDR1; /data/canopus/{stage2.bin,supervisor.elf,manager_icon.bin,bootstrap-word.txt} exist.
app/system/install_info_v1.db contains com.canopus.manager, so the Supervisor's app_install / launcher_load / launcher_insert / launcher_reset path completed.
control_flow_evidence: The previous src-9pro-3175 VFS records were wrong: open resolved to a battery/system routine that INVSTATE-faulted when the constructor opened /dev/canopus. EVID-PORT-9190-CORRECT re-matched them from the emulator-verified 3.1.32 records.
kmem_malloc must be the wrapper for the kmm descriptor 0x200b0840 (0xc0f11f4), not its Umem sibling 0xc0f1170.
The cave trampoline must preserve the NSH exec caller's LR; the previous blx/bx lr tail reused the blx return address and never returned.

launcher_load_app_info reads the metadata callback at +0x1c and app_install copies 0x3c bytes on 3.1.190; the 3.1.32 layout (+0x14) made it call the null page_registry slot. The v8 backend now selects the layout with CANOPUS_MGR_APPINFO_190.
Entry mode is 'cave': the mailbox entry probe calls exec_handler+0x45, an instruction boundary that does not hold for 3.1.190.
ownership_analysis: The Supervisor owns its Umem image and registry; the installer owns the staged files under /data/canopus. The Manager app and launcher entry are registered through the stock app_install/launcher path.
unsafe_assumptions: Emulator evidence only. No physical device probe; cache behaviour, MPU default-map execution and the Kmem/Umem split are not device-proven.
The Manager page and module install/activate flow were not exercised from the launcher; only the Supervisor load, device registration and CPC2 install steps were.
The v8 Manager's launcher-entry publish and notification service entries remain fail-closed stubs.
The Facetory Lua-layer patch is required to build the installer face; this run used the previously installed registered package slot.
recommended_probe: Repeat on a physical Band 9 Pro 3.1.190: Run, open the Manager from the launcher, install/enable/disable a module, and reboot with recovery.
